faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions before hitting the road? We've got you covered.

items.q: 01. Do I need to be an experienced cyclist to join ADCC rides?
items.a: Not at all! ADCC welcomes riders of all experience levels. We have beginner-friendly rides as well as advanced training sessions to suit everyone.

items.q: 02. Are there specific tracks for beginners or families?
items.a: Yes! We have several easy, flat tracks such as Corniche Seafront and Saadiyat Island Loop that are perfect for beginners and family outings.

items.q: 03. What gear do I need to bring for a group ride?
items.a: A road-worthy bike, a helmet, water, and appropriate cycling attire. We recommend lights for early morning or evening rides.

items.q: 04. Can I participate in races without being a professional?
items.a: Absolutely. Many of our races have categories for recreational riders. Check individual event details for age and skill category breakdowns.

items.q: 05. How do I track my performance or join challenges?
items.a: Download the ADCC app to log your rides, join challenges, and track your progress alongside thousands of community members.

items.q: 06. Are there any women-only rides or training sessions?
items.a: Yes! ADCC organises regular women-only rides and training sessions. Check our events calendar for upcoming sessions.
